question: Do words in Recipes paragraph rows show more e-run-length variation than label words, after controlling word pattern, scribe, section and page where possible?
status: New execution rules on previously exposed corpus; no claim of untouched confirmatory material. No numeric, phonetic or semantic assignment.
reading: H and F separately. Natural coverage primary; an additional common-source-locus inventory is descriptive only. No substitution of U/V for missing F labels. Retain all reading codes at focal chEol locations.
formats: Paragraph=P only. Label=source codes L or S optionally followed by digits. Exclude f49v L alphabet-like series. Source label status does not establish a name or referent. T/Q/R/X/circular text excluded; no relabelling to improve support.
cohorts: Recipes hand1/A is primary in H/F. Starred paragraphs remains a distinct section, not relabelled Recipes. All other known1..5 hand/section/variety strata reported as separate descriptive structural controls, never pooled as recipe evidence. Ambiguous hands excluded from contrasts.
feature: Replace each maximal nonempty literal EVA e-run with E, preserving all other characters and every run position. Variant is vector of lengths of all runs. No-run words excluded. Thus cheol/cheeol/cheeeol share chEol, but chol is separate and not added after inspection. Main all_runs view plus predeclared single_run sensitivity. No ch/sh collapse, no prefix deletion, no unknown repair.
variation: Unbiased pairwise diversity D=1-sum n_v(n_v-1)/(N(N-1)), the chance that two distinct observed tokens differ in e-run vector. Require at least2 tokens per format within the same skeleton. This removes simple sample-size bias of distinct-type counts, not all dependence or measurement error.
matching: Strict same-page+skeleton contrasts: compute Dparagraph-Dlabel for each supported skeleton; equal-weight mean skeleton gaps withinpage, then average page gaps within numbered leaf (recto/verso and panels of same numberedleaf grouped), then equal leaf means per cohort. Always preserve unsupported families and pages. No threshold chosen from outcome.
inference: Only primary Recipes H/F xall_runs/single_run get one-sided leaf sign-flip p, Bonferroni4. Exact all2^n if n<=20; else9999 fixedseed9510. Assume independent leaves and symmetric paired differences under null. If fewer than2leaves report descriptive only, no claim of adequate power even if a p is calculable. All other cohort and cross-page same-stratum contrasts descriptive only. No all-token exchangeability test or semantics from a pass.
secondary: Same-section+hand+variety skeleton contrasts pooled acrosspages descriptive only, as a fallback that cannot control page spelling setting. Fixed focal chEol counts acrossall sections/readings/formats, with missing/zero forms and alternatives explicit. No search for a better-looking skeleton.
qualification: Before manuscript feature counts: known word examples and multiple-run/zero-run/unknown definitions; D versus direct unordered-pair enumeration; exact null expectation for binary equal-distribution samples of sizes3 and2, all32outcomes, must be0. Positive12leaf authored contrast must have signflipT>0 and correctedp<.05; reversed must notpass; allzero controlp1. Exact sign-flip orbit upper-tail rank bound checked on12leaf authored differences. This qualifies counting/sample-size correction and a synthetic signal only.
limits: Recipe labels mostly absent in F is known metadata limitation. Multiple glyph e readings may be transcription conventions. A paragraph-label difference cannot establish counting, numeral values or a writing mechanism. Failure to estimate is not evidence of equality. No new herbal/zodiac links or sounds.
